title: Bon Voyage: NIO Unveils ONVO L60 Smart Electric SUV, Built on NVIDIA DRIVE Orin
description: NIO’s smart EV brand, ONVO, has unveiled the L60 flagship mid-size family SUV, built on the NVIDIA DRIVE Orin system-on-a-chip. Earlier this year, the automaker introduced the ONVO brand — which stands for On Voyage — to reinforce its commitment to bringing safer, smarter, and more enjoyable and affordable mobility solutions for the mainstream family […]
